result.paraphrase: Seagate ST8000NM0055 enterprise-class 8TB hard disk drive, model Enterprise Capacity v.5. SATA-6Gbps internal 3.5-inch HDD with 512e sectors, intended for hyperscale workloads, high-capacity RAID storage, mainstream enterprise external storage arrays (SAN, NAS, DAS), cloud data centers for replicated bulk data storage, enterprise backup and restore (D2D, virtual tape), and centralized surveillance. Features include a humidity sensor, super parity, low halogen design, PowerChoice technology, and advanced write caching (2M internal NOR flash). Performance specs: up to 237 MBPS sustained transfer rate at the outer diameter, 164 IOPS random read at 16QD WCE, 342 IOPS random write at 16QD WCE, 4.16 MS average latency, single interface port, 12.5 RAD/S² rotational vibration at 1500 HZ, 256 MB buffer, and 7200 RPM rotational speed. MTBF is 2 million hours.
